5704.title: PR detail reads have no shared request budget
5704.rootCauseOneLine: Ten-second per-environment caching does not bound aggregate PR detail and merge-queue reads or establish a shared quota cooldown.
5704.proposedFix: Define shared background-read budget, user-action reserve, and freshness policy before adding account/hostname-scoped admission control and PR-identity coalescing.
5704.caveats: Offline model verified twice. Actual GraphQL points and the original request initiator remain unverified. Reproduction source and output are inline; raw artifacts are not published. No PR: shared-budget/freshness policy exceeds the simple-fix gate.
